title: Precomputed results
text:
Welcome to the ELIXIR-UK RDM Club notebook showcase.
This site presents four Quarto notebooks providing precomputed results as a starting point for discussion focused on different scenarios in each of the breakout rooms. The notebooks are rendered as part of the site build; readers do not need to run the analyses.

title: Breakout room - Handed a dataset
text:
Load R packages

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(scRNAseq))

title: Breakout room - Handed a dataset
text:
Fetch data

sce.zeisel <- ZeiselBrainData(
  ensembl = TRUE, # use Ensembl identifiers rather than gene symbols (default: FALSE)
  location = TRUE, # include genomic coordinates (default: FALSE)
  legacy = FALSE   # pull data from gypsum backend, not ExperimentHub
)
